d: Needs 1 L and 10 days to harden into resin.
x: Fresh Resin

Collected by placing a spile into a pine or acacia log and a liquid container directly beneath it.
Pine trees produce resin in cool to hot conditions (5°C to 40°C).
Acacia trees are not as hardy as pine trees. They will produce resin in temperate to hot conditions (15°C to 40°C), and will produce less resin per day.
